Counts are PLANNED, not released. This slate is separate from the 12-film Olympian slate on media.html; whether the two canons merge is an open owner decision (docs/SPEC_RECONCILIATION.md). Allowed statuses: CONCEPT, IN DEVELOPMENT, IN PRODUCTION, RELEASED, each of which needs evidence in this file before use.

franchises.title: ZODIAC WARS
franchises.pitch: In a universe where the twelve Zodiac Gods rule entire planets and command civilizations across the Solar System, an ancient cosmic war reignites when the Solar Nexus awakens. Humanity becomes caught between Light Zodiac rulers, Shadow Zodiac counterparts, forgotten primordial guardians, and an existential force known as the Null, a self-aware collapse of reality itself.

canon.note: Section 1 of the bible is the founder's text; everything else is proposed and awaits approval.
